notes.title: Hidden Cats 5: Magic Tree - 😸🐾Released!🐾😻
notes.content: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3921850/HIDDEN_CATS_5_Magic_Tree"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190673/50ec40188388b239666975a0ba05bd4716996b6c.png"][/img][/p][p]The continuation of the Hidden Cats 5: Magic Tree game series is released. You will have to find cleverly cats hiding in the foliage of the magical tree and paint black - white locations with colored paints. Interesting, attention-grabbing picture, 101 cute cats and pleasant atmospheric music are waiting for you. And also in time of release will be published DLC with an additional location on the same theme but larger in size, where you will be waiting for 200 cats.[/p]

notes.title: Hidden Cats: Aetherpunk is coming soon. 🐾 Add to wishlist!😻
notes.content: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3919920/HIDDEN_CATS_4_Aetherpunk/?curator_clanid=40622694"][/dynamiclink]For cats lovers, the sequel to the Hidden Cats: Aetherpunk game series is coming soon. Add it to your wishlist so you don't miss the game's release! You will have to explore the amazing world of fantasy steampunk. Find cleverly hidden cats and paint black - white locations with colored paints. Interesting, attention-attracting picture, cute cats and nice atmospheric music are waiting for you.[/p]

notes.title: Find All 7: Japan - Released!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3491570/FIND_ALL_7_Japan/
The continuation of the Find All 7: Japan series is out! Explore the amazing world of mysterious Japan, finding different items and paint black - white locations with colored paints. Interesting, attention-grabbing picture, 150 themed items and pleasant atmospheric music are waiting for you. During the release will be released DLC with an additional location on the same theme but larger in size, where you will be waiting for 250 items.. Don't forget to add 2 our next games to your wish list. They will be bigger, more interesting and exciting, and will also include different mini games and participate in the summer festival!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3637730/FIND_ALL_8_The_road_to_the_Maya/

notes.title: Minor inaccuracies in drawings have been corrected
notes.content:
Minor inaccuracies in drawings have been corrected.
- There are no longer crowns on shields that are not considered searchable.
- No more cheese and crowns on coins, which are also not considered searchable.
- Cheese on the shield is a bit finalized, it is definitely there :)
Added Japanese language.
Added Czech language.
Thanks to everyone who reports inaccuracies and is so attentive to our games.
